reviews.performance: Executes complete bundles serially and stores all results; explicit maximumCases bounds an optional subset and percentile computation is small.
reviews.reliability: Requires unique valid case IDs, SQLite primary, expected top-ten path and complete bundle; output is written before failure. Null arrays/elements and actual persisted evidence growth need invalid-input tests.

reviews.performance: Thin adapter reuses the shared reader and one aggregate stopwatch per single/batch operation; batch avoids per-query telemetry writes.
reviews.reliability: Cancellation/expected fingerprint are propagated and timing is recorded in finally without query data. The adapter delegates all state/limit/transaction enforcement to the linked ranking core.

reviews.performance: Concrete SQLite batches reuse one read snapshot; fake/interface readers retain sequential evaluation. Metrics store all corpus results and timing arrays.
reviews.reliability: Schema, limits and duplicate IDs are checked, but null case/criteria arrays and threshold ranges need fixtures. Ready is recorded rather than included in the aggregate passed criterion; caller gates must reject unavailable states independently.

reviews.performance: Runs complete bundles serially and serializes compact context per case; warm timing excludes only the first case. Shared equivalent queries can reuse service cache, but representativeness of warm/cold metrics needs explicit workload controls.
reviews.reliability: Ranking/scope/named-test/required-path invariants are strict and thresholds explicit. Null/invalid threshold and expected-layer values need validation. HasFocusedChecks treats any nonempty recommended/discovery list as a check, which is planning evidence rather than executed coverage.

reviews.performance: Full 1,878-line inspection: batch reuses one read transaction and metadata; ordinary search issues metadata plus lexical, identity, compound, guidance and runtime recalls. reviews.performance: Bounded view/limit wrapper; delegates to Node query and reconstructs each group before JSON serialization. Cold subprocess and readiness refresh dominate this small formatter; measure an in-process contract route before sharing the reader.
reviews.reliability: Rejects unavailable projection explicitly and permits only SQLite. Diagnostic fields are computed even when JSON omits them; no new correctness defect established.

reviews.performance: Same bounded Node-query/group-hydration pattern as frontend contracts, with deeper JSON output. An in-process contract reader could remove process/serialization overhead while preserving grouping and ordering.
reviews.reliability: Explicit ready check and SQLite-only parameter preserve unavailable behavior; test parity on all views and ambiguous/unconsumed contracts before changing execution.

reviews.reliability: Reader owns readiness enforcement; view and limit are validated. Text hydration is bounded by reader output. Caller does not itself establish an atomic read snapshot.

reviews.performance: In-process reader and immediate JSON pass-through are efficient. The later JSON reserialization/complete-duration branch is unreachable; diagnostics-only SQL counts belong in reader optimization, not this formatter.
reviews.reliability: SQLite-only view/limit validation and explicit reader errors remain. Text deserialization has bounded groups; no independent defect established in this wrapper.

reviews.performance: Still reads the complete runtime-topology JSON solely for its freshness header, hashes all runtime sources and then queries SQLite. Move freshness metadata into the SQLite projection and share command-owned inventory/hash work after exact freshness parity measurement.
reviews.reliability: Separates empty index from an empty filtered result and exposes verified source fingerprint plus conservative behavioral recall guidance. Retain those states and the declaration-versus-production evidence boundary.

reviews.performance: Readiness uses status, optional backend-only build, and another status; query recovery retries only after unavailable. Several wrappers can duplicate these subprocesses; batch readiness by exact worktree fingerprint, never by process-global freshness assumptions.
reviews.reliability: Both entrypoints recheck readiness after bounded recovery and throw if still unavailable. Inspect manager serialization/locks and exit propagation before treating recovery as race-safe.

reviews.performance: Normalizes one broad-intent prefix and delegates to ranked context with cache bypass, then emits at most Limit entries. Consider cache reuse only if broad-intent normalization is included in identity.
reviews.reliability: Always labels the returned list as abstained and unconclusive and never fabricates a chain. Nullable candidate/metadata shape still depends on FindContext; preserve explicit unavailable status if extending this result.

reviews.performance: One Node search followed by bounded formatting and aggregate telemetry. A native explanation reader could share compact features and remove another process, but must retain individual scoring reasons.
reviews.reliability: Input search readiness is recorded only to telemetry; the public explanation omits ready/unavailableReason and maps missing records to an empty list. Validate unavailable-result propagation with an owned fixture before classifying a finding; query text is returned, not persisted here.

reviews.performance: Small adapter over task baseline; Git/hash cost belongs to the baseline implementation. No extra repository traversal.
reviews.reliability: Keeps baseline availability and separates task paths from concurrent/preexisting paths. commitsAhead contributes to drift; do not interpret unavailable zero/default fields as proof of clean continuity.

reviews.performance: Pure map and path classification over small inputs; no I/O. Replace repeated membership arrays only if caller supplies large deltas and profiling justifies a set.
reviews.reliability: Deferral requires every failure to map to a modified artifact; unknown generators conservatively block. Counts can be distorted by duplicate FailedTool values, so validate call-site uniqueness. Generated module pages have no mapping and therefore block safely.

reviews.performance: Each page review scans every Wiki markdown file and reads every line before hashing sources and reloading the ledger. Grouped review repeatedly performs that work; command-owned page-id/frontmatter lookup and one locked ledger update are promising measured followups.
reviews.reliability: NUL-safe Git paths and normalized content identity are sound. Whole-ledger Set-Content lacks an atomic writer lock, so concurrent reviews may lose entries; duplicate page ids rely on separate lint enforcement. Validate concurrency before fixing.

reviews.performance: Enumerates ready markers once and cleans only slots beyond retention. Per-slot locks preserve active readers; cleanup calls one worktree removal per legacy slot plus prune.
reviews.reliability: Checks absolute slot containment and SHA-shaped names before recursive removal, retaining lock identity. Reparse-point containment and incomplete slots without ready markers require the snapshot producer review; IOException locks are conservatively treated as busy.

reviews.performance: Normalizes distinct candidate paths, runs one Node owner query and adds timing metadata. Process/readiness overhead exceeds formatter work; measure shared reader/batched owner queries against exact render-chain parity.
reviews.reliability: Explicit unavailable throw, bounded limit and SQLite-only execution are retained. Result shape relies on runtimeOwner being present when ready; no independent defect established.

reviews.performance: Pure text formatter with one experiment and issue traversal; no repository or process cost.
reviews.reliability: Handles absent plural/singular top-level fields and null experiments; nested shadow/currentEvaluation members rely on the manager contract and should be exercised with malformed/partial results if that contract expands.

reviews.performance: Shared plural/singular adapters prevent duplicate enumeration logic; formatting cost is proportional to supplied items and issues.
reviews.reliability: No persistence or state change; callers own validation of nested promotion/health payloads. Avoid generic success interpretation from the displayed valid field without checking manager verdicts.

reviews.performance: Reads one draft, validates query completeness/duplication and writes/hashes one frozen corpus. Hashes the draft after parsing, so file publication/identity should be measured and checked together.
reviews.reliability: Force protects existing output but writes are not atomic and draft schema, duplicate ids and nonempty case/target set are not checked here. Declared authorship remains explicitly unproven; path parameters permit caller-selected external artifacts intentionally.

reviews.performance: Checks minimum count/provenance and every evidence path before one output serialization/hash. Repeated identical evidence paths could share command-owned existence checks; typical corpus size is bounded by input, not MinimumCaseCount.
reviews.reliability: Validates ids, declared provenance and lexical repository containment, but existing output can be overwritten without Force and nested threshold ranges are not validated. Symlink containment and atomic freeze identity require focused tests; provenance declaration never proves independence.

reviews.performance: Uses one Node trace and preserves direct SQLite metadata. Compact affects display only: nested route/consumer arrays can still be large before formatting; measure SQL hydration bounds rather than truncating transport evidence blindly.
reviews.reliability: Custom JSON fixtures are rejected, unavailable projection throws, and text no-match exits 1 while JSON returns a structured no-match result. Preserve that deliberate format-specific contract.

reviews.performance: Three Git enumerations plus existence scans per manifest phase; gather one normalized change set and memoize overlapping declared paths.
reviews.reliability: Raw text Git paths can be quoted for Unicode, and the current HEAD/unstaged/untracked union omits staged-only changes. Validate both with a real owned phase manifest before fixing; implemented means path changed, not tested or accepted.

reviews.performance: One journey lookup followed by linear scenario formatting and a small generic scenario set. Repository lookup cost belongs to the journey owner.
reviews.reliability: Labels derived scenarios as a plan, not executed QA. Generic tests are always suggested regardless of relevance; future grounding should preserve concrete journey ids and avoid duplicate QA ids when journeys reuse a scenario.

reviews.performance: Walks ancestor directories for the first test source and emits commands without running them. Multiple planned test projects are ignored after the first; reuse a source-to-project map only when expanding the plan.
reviews.reliability: Coverage is explicitly not assertion proof. Nonexistent planned file paths can start ancestor discovery at a filename; a directory with multiple projects chooses the first rather than reporting ambiguity. Generated shell commands use caller-derived namespace/class/path strings and require review before execution.

reviews.performance: Accepts DiffInput and PolicyInput to avoid duplicate expensive child queries, but rereads all ADR bodies and regex-matches each change-derived term. A command-owned ADR term index could amortize repeated briefs.
reviews.reliability: Terms are regex-escaped; deterministic policy rule establishes required review, while matching ADRs are navigation. ADR enumeration/matched-term order follows platform enumeration/hash-set order and should be made ordinal before portable output parity claims.

reviews.performance: One bounded graph impact query then affinity sorts and groups. graphLimit is capped at 100 even when output Limit=500; increasing the user limit cannot expand upstream recall. Repeated path-affinity normalization per sort can share scoped prefixes.
reviews.reliability: Requires explicit paths/module, reports static limitations and never silently guesses the scope. Modules currentProject is inferred from nearest unique project, while sibling project ambiguity becomes null. Confidence based on nonempty static edges is not execution coverage; preserve that distinction.

reviews.performance: Small in-memory FTS fixture exercises 160 rows with large bodies and several limits. EXPLAIN checks bounded final rowid hydration without imposing machine-dependent timing budgets.
reviews.reliability: Checks path diversity, ties, missing feature exclusion and independent reference parity. Reference sorting uses localeCompare while production SQL uses binary ordering; add non-ASCII/tie paths before claiming portable sort coverage.

reviews.performance: In-memory fixtures share source-reader statements and compare incremental versus full replacement, avoiding full repository builds. Large body appears only in one focused case.
reviews.reliability: Covers source ordering/duplicates/live changes, dense ordinals, all mirrors, invalid/stale cache recovery and rollback/retry. These are data-integrity tests, not throughput benchmarks or independent proof of transaction ownership in every caller.

reviews.performance: One owned artifact fixture refreshes 12 small compiled sources and tests no-op and one-source regeneration. All ordinary query limits are small.
reviews.reliability: Covers Unicode/spaces, literal SQL-looking text, nested sections, zero-count groups, missing/stale/schema errors and security signal selection. Resolved parent containment protects recursive cleanup; fixture payloads are simplified and do not prove real-large-index latency.

reviews.performance: Compares bounded asynchronous input reads to an independent serial reference with forced out-of-order completion, skipped files, dirty metadata and failure draining. Uses small artificial delays rather than performance budgets.
reviews.reliability: Covers exact counters, same-size/time edits, missing/error paths and worker limits. Writer-lock test evaluates a source slice with injected dependencies, proving that function behavior but not that every real build calls it correctly. Temp recursive cleanup has no additional containment assertion.

reviews.performance: Backs up the real graph once and invokes three full writer builds on a private database; source extraction/readiness dominates its cost. A small source fixture could reduce time if a separate real-repository recovery case remains.
reviews.reliability: Repairs actual missing identity/features with unchanged fingerprints and verifies exact rows/counts. Requires a prepared real source database and a nonempty feature projection; not standalone on a clean checkout. Root cleanup uses mkdtemp under owned artifacts but lacks an explicit resolved-prefix assertion.

reviews.performance: Tiny WAL fixture validates online backup without repeated project extraction. No elapsed-time assertions.
reviews.reliability: Checks committed WAL rows, sidecar removal, integrity and missing-source publication. Does not yet exercise reader leases, destination replacement failure, concurrent writer updates during backup or bounded backup timeout; cleanup remains mkdtemp-owned.

reviews.performance: Despite its name this is a correctness suite: ownership-cache reference parity, maintenance, Markdown repair, bounded identity recall and batch snapshot invariants. Small in-memory data and fake process errors keep most cases inexpensive.
reviews.reliability: Covers stale cached hits/misses, missing/orphan/duplicate mirrors, relocated ownership, literal spans, unknown projects, alias layers, Unicode morphology, snapshot consistency and error precedence. It establishes no wall-time speedup or p95 budget. Real child calls and temp fixture cleanup require process-helper/caller safeguards, reviewed separately.

reviews.performance: One bounded graph impact plus directory enumeration for proposed scopes. Get-ChildItem -Recurse filters afterward and may walk dependency/build trees before First limits; prefer graph/Git source inventory with exclusion before descent, while retaining direct test discovery.
reviews.reliability: Distinguishes required direct tests from recommended static consumers and flags broad frontend scopes. Scoped directories discover JS/TS specs only; C# tests rely on graph consumers. Required arrays are capped without explicit truncation evidence, and scope input slash normalization occurs after distinct selection.

reviews.performance: Reads 300 commits across all refs, then repeatedly normalizes scope directories while scoring every changed path. Precompute those prefixes and use literal path-scoped history when it does not change the specified all-ref ranking contract.
reviews.reliability: Git paths are parsed from text lines, so quoted Unicode paths and unusual newline/@@@ filenames require a NUL-safe record format. Explicitly describes history as precedent, not current authority; matching a commit path does not prove the referenced pattern still exists.

reviews.performance: Governed status delegates to one delivery assessment; otherwise an objective triggers one adaptive routing assessment. Already branches away from costly context when idle.
reviews.reliability: Labels idle, not-started and governed states separately. Both status/next show the same derived action list and do not mutate state; ready depends on delivery.valid, which needs owning assessor validation rather than assuming every required gate has executed.

reviews.performance: ResearchInput allows reuse of an existing packet; otherwise full research can dominate one-question selection. Current selection sorts every open question; typical counts are small and stable.
reviews.reliability: Prioritizes blocking then id, handles no questions and preserves unavailable source anchors. Supplied ResearchInput is trusted as a packet shape and does not independently verify grounded line identity or why only human input can resolve it; callers must preserve that boundary.

reviews.performance: Reuses diff/policy/ownership/test/rollout/ADR/brief outputs across seven child tools, reducing duplicate discovery. Serialization can still produce a large nested packet; command-owned shared source lookup would further amortize brief/ADR scans.
reviews.reliability: Resolves BaseRef once and uses exact authority inputs, but packet fingerprint includes only HEAD, refs, changed path names and objective, not current content or policy identity. Do not use it as an exact evidence cache key without a content-fingerprint test. Output writes are caller-selected and not atomic.

reviews.performance: Builds one reverse adjacency map and linear BFS, safely handling cycles. Nearest-AGENTS existence checks repeat for each file; share per-directory lookups when deltas span hundreds of sources.
reviews.reliability: Uses declared module graph, not inferred runtime ownership. Handles nonexistent/deleted file paths lexically; explicit directory scopes need nearest-guide tests because traversal starts at the parent. DiffInput shape is trusted as owning diff output.

reviews.performance: Three policy/registry/schedule reads and repeated capability-by-agent-by-task filtering. Pre-index capabilities and reuse one policy/registry snapshot when analyzing large fleets.
reviews.reliability: Validity establishes capability presence, not available-capacity or lease/scheduling feasibility. Demand lists include whatever states the schedule supplies and supporting agents depend on registry filtering; verify those owner contracts before changing gap semantics.

reviews.performance: Caches each candidate source body once but scans every body for eleven filename substrings. A single pass matching all names and a narrower Git inventory can bound memory/read cost; current scan includes all tracked/new PS, MJS and Markdown sources.
reviews.reliability: Hardcoded migration status is a declared route, not runtime proof; consumer discovery is textual and omits C# readers. Generators count as consumers, conservatively retaining projection sources. Text ls-files can quote Unicode paths, and removable must not be treated as sufficient deletion authorization.

reviews.performance: Flattens two policy snapshots and compares sorted union of leaf keys in one pass. Empty containers emit no leaves, while id-bearing arrays intentionally use id rather than position.
reviews.reliability: Reports missing semantic snapshot distinctly from changed fingerprint. Single-segment workspace regex also accepts dot/dot-dot names; duplicate ids and empty-container additions/removals can collapse semantic evidence. Validate descriptor/policy owner constraints and concrete fixtures before classifying defects.

reviews.performance: Read all 2,987 baseline lines: source inventory is memoized per process, bounded async reads finish before one write transaction, incremental projections avoid rewriting unchanged records and batch search pins one snapshot. Remaining costs include two complete dirty-worktree hashes per build, complete compiled JSON freshness reads on queries, unbounded runtime-suffix recall, full-row compiled/frontend trace scans, repeated query-invariant normalization inside ranking, and lineAt rescanning each source prefix. Measure hoisted invariants, source-owned line maps and bounded SQL hydration with exact ranking/trace parity before claiming gains.
reviews.reliability: Real Node/MCP rename fixtures exposed endpoint mismatch, OEM decoding and case-sensitive identity/order differences; fixed with both rename endpoints, explicit MCP UTF-8 and shared UTF-16 ordinal order. Other validation candidates: non-build actions invoke writable schema initialization without build lock; child extractor/Git processes lack independent deadlines; stale-lock recovery can race a replacement owner; missing query/compiled sources are skipped rather than clearing old rows; ordinary multi-statement readers lack pinned transactions; path-stdin JSON is rejoined with semicolons; localeCompare ties can differ from ordinal C# ranking. Corruption quarantine, write rollback, explicit incomplete TypeScript marker and stable source-before/after checks are retained.

reviews.performance: Cold route performs status, optional build/status, in-process search and possibly a second test search; cached JSON still validates workspace before reuse. Repeated scope-coverage passes and JSON budget reserialization are bounded by searchLimit<=100. Share one read snapshot and query-owned normalized scope sets before pursuing process-level caches.
reviews.reliability: Explicit readiness, TypeScript completeness, fingerprint validation, ambiguity and compact scope-budget failure remain. Legacy-shaped module dependencies/consumers are empty navigation fields, not dependency proof. Status is captured before queries and ordinary reader transaction/freshness races need owning-reader validation; stored timings on cache hits are correctly labelled.

reviews.performance: One bounded search followed by module inventory scans, repeated optional-property copying and nearest-guide checks. Explicit inventory owner prevents unnecessary candidate expansion; a shared normalized module lookup can amortize repeated queries.
reviews.reliability: Exact single module ownership can be conclusive from inventory independently of search readiness. Ranked standalone results rely on SkipRefresh/caller snapshot freshness rather than independently checking it; Services root fallback is absent when indexed module identity is missing. Unsupported JSON branch is unreachable under Sqlite-only ValidateSet.

reviews.performance: Reads two small catalogs and repeatedly regex-matches aliases/module names/path patterns per journey. Precompute normalized exact phrases and path matches for large deltas; keep representative audit sampling separate from direct matches.
reviews.reliability: Schema and optional FailOnNone are enforced; sampled journeys remain navigation and not execution evidence. Match regexes have no explicit timeout, catalog aliases/scenarios are trusted and truncation exposes returned count rather than total match count. Validate malformed catalog and large intent limits before hardening.

reviews.performance: Runs readiness status, bounded category query and another status. Area filtering occurs after SQL limit, so overfetch up to 100 still cannot prove adequate Wiki recall; push ownership/area filtering into SQL before limits with view parity.
reviews.reliability: Static test-reference absence is explicitly not execution coverage. Wiki path classifier still contains retired tests/FoodDiary.Development.Mcp.Tests rather than current Tooling/tests root; validate real-index presence before a defect claim. Product diversity groups all physical Modules under one top-level bucket, which is a navigation-quality followup.

reviews.performance: Broad/default review issues four separate context searches plus one SQLite evidence query. Batch context recall and shared readiness/source hashes can remove repeated process and source verification cost without truncating evidence families.
reviews.reliability: Clear navigation-only, static-test and production-control limits avoid a scanner/verdict claim. Hardcoded representative topics may age as integrations move; confidence from a bounded search is not verified security. Required source files are checked before querying; evidence readiness is owned by the query helper.

reviews.performance: Resolves optional Git scope, readiness, one SQLite query and a PowerShell ranking/truncation pass. SQLite currently materializes the entire selected sensitive category; diagnostics report only retained JSON bytes rather than every hydrated row. Measure early SQL scope/term filtering while preserving score ordering.
reviews.reliability: Separates summary-only, explicit/repository scope, focused empty abstention and handling guidance. Git scope is NUL-safe but rename-aware source endpoints need a scope-out regression. Scope path token aliases and dynamic category are navigation, not an authorization or privacy-safety verdict.

reviews.performance: Reads/lowercases every candidate PS/workflow/registry body for each query, even for name matches, and ranks the complete set. A compiled tool text projection or pass-owned body cache can reduce repeated bytes after equality and freshness checks.
reviews.reliability: Input token regex is ASCII-only, so a Cyrillic-only tooling question may return no candidates. MJS/CS runtime sources are not candidate paths, making this a partial tool navigator; returned groundedPaths means existing matches rather than verified behavior.

reviews.performance: Computes path eligibility cheaply but always builds a full compact test plan even for an ineligible delta. Return the rejection first or accept a prebuilt test plan when no caller relies on rejected-result test evidence.
reviews.reliability: Rejects non-UI and manifest/public-api boundary expansions; JSON reports eligibility without nonzero exit while text exits 2. Bookkeeping-only changes can pass eligibility with no actual UI source; owning facade should verify an established UI session rather than treating this as user approval.

reviews.performance: Reads every workspace/evidence and every retained metric/outcome file, then sorts and groups. Bound retention at producers and reuse one parsed metric pass; larger historical directories otherwise grow report latency.
reviews.reliability: Corrupt metric/outcome files are silently omitted while corrupt workspace descriptors fail. Existence of completion.json labels a workspace sealed without validating it. Parent and child durations can be double-counted in totalDurationSeconds, and active workspace plus durable outcome may count the same task twice; treat values as operation/adoption observations, not wall-time or causal quality proof.

reviews.performance: Accepts shared diff/policy objects and then performs small path/rule scans; no deployment or external calls occur. Compile matched flags once only if reused across packets.
reviews.reliability: Generic guidance is inferred from path names and scopes, not deployed state. New module Providers/Configurations not named by legacy roots can miss specialized flags; retain policy review obligations and validate real changed owner paths before altering classification.

reviews.performance: Accepts workflow/research/brief input reuse, but absent inputs independently invoke all three heavy routes. Pass one composed packet and avoid duplicate discovery in packet/design callers.
reviews.reliability: Bounds each edge category, retains empty-category investigation gaps and distinguishes recommendation from proof. Dynamic/external edges are explicitly not covered; heuristic recommendation flags and truncated lists do not establish complete consumer or side-effect assessment.

reviews.performance: Current-path existence and optional Git precedents are shared across all alternatives. Main cost is one historical scan; generic option scoring itself is small.
reviews.reliability: Classification/cost/recommendation rely on English keyword heuristics and the first bounded option, not an actual acceptance test or measured cost. Precedent errors become an empty list, indistinguishable from no history. Structural boundary evidence is caller-declared and requires source verification.

reviews.performance: Builds research and then an implementation plan without passing the already-composed brief, potentially repeating expensive discovery. Reuse a verified packet/brief and collect phase fields once when compiling several design views.
reviews.reliability: Any nonempty Decision input resolves resolve-design-boundary; ready also requires grounded paths but not evaluated acceptance or unresolved structural violations. Generated vertical slices are guidance and must never shrink the user objective or substitute a tested small slice for full completion.

reviews.performance: Git batches changed/inventory paths once and reads baseline blobs only for changed manifests. RepositoryWide parses every manifest, while lockfiles are hashed/read only when changed; memoized shared props could reduce repeated dependency parsing.
reviews.reliability: NUL-safe paths and no-renames include deletion evidence. HeadRef is unsupported, so supplied branch-only queries use working-tree semantics; dependency groups flatten into one package map, and central Directory.Packages.props is absent from inventory. Record versions as manifest evidence, never vulnerability verdicts.

reviews.performance: BriefInput prevents repeated research and output is built by bounded arrays/phases. Large consumer sets are truncated before plan compilation; surface omitted obligations rather than simply increasing default limits.
reviews.reliability: Normalization and fallback decision/rollout objects allow partial input; callers must not treat a generated phase list as evaluated acceptance. finalGates deduplicates by command, potentially coalescing distinct policy ids; inspect evidence consumers before changing that representation. reviews.performance: Builds a receipt map once, but repeatedly filters failed receipts per workspace/owner and scans agents per candidate. Grouped counts and identity maps can preserve output order.
reviews.reliability: Stable exclusive watchdog lease; explicit Apply controls failure/quarantine/circuit actions. reviews.reliability: Stable exclusive circuit lease; packet changes/cooldown reset state and predecessor closure survives retention. Source-watchdog linkage and workspace lexical containment require their own upstream validation, not inferred security findings.

reviews.performance: Claim revalidates plan/hash/TTL/policy/workspace fingerprints, lease occupancy and agent capacity. List/prune read all plan/claim/cycle JSON; request-local maps can reduce repeated joins.

reviews.performance: Small owned policy fixture exercises warm cache and uncached validation without graph builds.

reviews.performance: Each target/source verifies bundle then budget, which verifies bundle again; create/compare then recomputes the whole benchmark. Shared immutable verified inputs could remove nested duplicate scans.
reviews.reliability: Requires comparable tasks and gates required coverage/security/quarantine before quality verdict. Saved verification checks arithmetic/input hashes, not regeneration of all results; exact variant/recommendation-set integrity needs fixtures.

reviews.performance: Accepts an exact-scope PacketInput to avoid repeating full packet compilation; criteria suggestions repeatedly scan paths/tests/scenarios and evidence validation searches arrays per mapping. Preindexed IDs and token/path lookups are candidates.

Validation accepts one verified mapped check/review or an evidence note, not all mappings; broad criterion evidence and direct-write concurrency need owning proof validation.

reviews.performance: Compiles brief once and reuses it for the implementation plan, but validation recomputes both and then scans scope/check/review/evidence arrays. Shared immutable inputs and ID maps are candidates.

Missing planned paths are reported but not blocking here; stored plan fingerprint is not explicitly checked in validate, and Git HEAD/base commands rely on caller cwd.

reviews.performance: One graph build followed by seven bounded view queries and one source-hash probe; recorded durations are currently unused in output.

Independent before/after AST comparison proves only one assertion replacement; updated governed/orchestration hashes reflect fresh-orphan stable-lock recovery with unchanged counts. CI matrix, isolated partitions and exhaustive default stay required.

reviews.performance: Reads whole source files into line arrays before extracting bounded excerpts; constructs regexes for every excerpt and filters feedback/security arrays per candidate. Verify composes memory, promotion, experiment and security validation plus source hashes.
reviews.reliability: Checks source/registry/security drift and item/character budgets. Create reports structural success before Test-Bundle; redaction/quarantine can change excerpt length after truncation. Compare reads saved bundles without verifying them. Candidate path containment, out-of-range lines and coherent text/hash snapshots need fixtures.

reviews.performance: Rebuilds current change policy and dependency fingerprints for each check/review, then launches runtime version detection. Shared request-owned policy/version inputs could reduce repeat work.
reviews.reliability: Binds kind, source rule, command/definition, dependency content, policy/runtime/platform. Manual and executed evidence remain distinct. Native version exit status is not independently checked; raw JSON fingerprint portability and source-rule association require explicit tests.

reviews.performance: Reads and rewrites one full session registry; reconciliation scans active sessions and workspace existence. One-hour age threshold limits premature reconciliation.
reviews.reliability: Read-only mode tolerates unreadable registry and never persists reconciliation. Ambiguous active sessions require a stable hint. Mutations have no lock/atomic publication, no schema validation here, and hint identity is not the generated session ID.

reviews.performance: Path profiles repeatedly scan all valid receipts, and every receipt rereads its dispatch; list computes complete quality-adjustment metrics too. Preindexed per-path/per-dispatch data could preserve output at lower cost.
reviews.reliability: Requires terminal dispatch, owner, bundle hash and disjoint helpful/noisy/missing sets. Missing retained dispatch links are tolerated. Record has an existence-check/write race; test override lexical prefix lacks a separator and needs owned containment validation.

reviews.performance: Validates/hash-serializes every event and sorts profiles twice for variant/cohort views; observe additionally verifies strategy and retrospective.
reviews.reliability: Explicit invalid/insufficient-data/degraded states and bounded event count remain. Observation writes registry and workspace receipt separately without locking/rollback. Prune rechains retained events, potentially changing historic workspace links; profile marks valid without using registry validity.

reviews.performance: Canonical application hash excludes large base64 bodies and validates byte snapshots separately, avoiding deep serialization cost. Apply regenerates bundle/budget and compares the same workspace as both benchmark sides.
reviews.reliability: Binds approval to exact experiment/recommendation/policy and validates saved snapshots/current artifacts. Mutations are not one transaction and can partially replace artifacts before application publication. Explicit reason policy is local tool behavior; no action was invoked during review.

reviews.performance: Each completed repair scans prior failed attempts again; promotion revalidates full repair/learning histories and rewrites registry. Prefix counts and request-local verified views are candidates.
reviews.reliability: Checks chain, sequence, duplicate fingerprints, categories and bounds. Confidence casts lengths to string before numeric comparison, requiring short-text regressions. Registry writes have no lock/atomic replacement and promoted proof remains hash-referenced rather than executed here.

reviews.performance: Reads four artifacts and hashes them separately, then runs lineage validation; each criterion searches evidence mappings. Request-local parsed inputs and ID maps can remove repeated scans.
reviews.reliability: Binds classification/verdict to exact inputs and recomputes proof on verify. Pending criteria make proof not applicable; an evidence note can satisfy verified-evidence presence. Saved invalid proof can exist, while result still distinguishes integrity from validity.

reviews.performance: Builds one packet and compares fresh/reused acceptance init; multiple negative cases avoid full discovery through injected packet input.
reviews.reliability: Protects complete matrix parity and rejects objective/base/scope/head/schema mismatches without rewriting target; reuse is allowed only for init and explicit nonempty workspace scope.

reviews.performance: Repeated path-by-pattern scans and per-planned-path actual scans dominate larger scopes; compiled path patterns and indexed command/review sets are candidates.
reviews.reliability: Recomputes classification and hashes exact manifest/policy/diff. Explicit replan journals its reason and restores three prior files on exceptions. Multi-file rollback is not concurrency-isolated; generated/governance exclusions depend on whether Wiki was planned as product scope.

reviews.performance: Near-duplicate detection compares each criterion pair and repeatedly tokenizes/reclassifies the same texts. Precomputed type/token sets retain identical Jaccard behavior with lower cost.
reviews.reliability: Separates advisory recommendations from corrective expansion and keeps new split criteria pending. Expansion rewrites acceptance, removes proof, creates receipt and journals without one transaction. Type/vagueness rules are language heuristics, not proof of user intent.

reviews.performance: Rehashes all attempts for registry identity and again during validation; suggestions scan knowledge and promoted learnings. Check-indexed views and one canonical payload pass could reduce work.
reviews.reliability: Requires failed checks, permitted repair paths, one active attempt, bounded repeats and fresh passed evidence before completion. Complete/fail do not enforce Owner or current packet/policy equality against the attempt; no writer lock protects read-modify-write.

reviews.performance: Verifies risk/repair/learning/telemetry, then invokes relevant repair-learning query per evidence check. One verified learning map could avoid repeated full-registry validation.
reviews.reliability: Verify recomputes current inputs but validates saved signal arithmetic/check set rather than every current historic signal. Aggregate-only repair hash drift is deliberately ignored while per-attempt hashes remain authoritative. Calibration treats a repair attempt as observed failure; this is a heuristic forecast.

reviews.performance: Forecast revalidates prediction and rereads telemetry/learning/experiments already used upstream; per-check scans join historical metrics and overrides. Assessment regenerates only invalid saved forecasts.
reviews.reliability: Checks fields, positive durations, arithmetic/totals, policy/packet and applied-learning provenance. It does not explicitly compare the full saved check-ID set to current requirements. Forecast savings and relative values are not measured execution durations.

reviews.performance: Create computes current risk/prediction/plan/outcomes, then Test-Receipt repeats that composition. Route/profile joins are repeated linear scans over small policy sets.
reviews.reliability: Recomputes canonical recommendation, alternatives, input hashes and risk floors. Scores/cost units are internal policy heuristics, not evidence that a particular model is best; no model choice or external account mutation was performed.

reviews.performance: Create builds risk/prediction/cost then re-verifies all through Get-Current; run refreshes workspace after each execution and again at end. Shared immutable contexts and ID maps could reduce nested work.
reviews.reliability: Verifies canonical selection, exact once-only coverage, policy/input hashes and commands. Consolidated covered checks are recorded as manual lineage after actual primary success. Plan/evidence writes are not transactionally isolated, and execution has no independent deadline here.

reviews.performance: New critique invokes seven assessments plus telemetry/security/confidence, and Test-Critique immediately repeats it. This amplifies nested parsing and validation already identified in confidence.
reviews.reliability: Recomputes areas/findings/arithmetic and checks telemetry/confidence/artifact drift. Integrity validity is separate from approve/reject verdict. Atomic publication, complete artifact-hash sets and bounded serialization need fixtures.

reviews.performance: Reads many sealed artifacts, composes prediction/cost/repair/telemetry, then creation recomputes retrospective for validation. A pinned telemetry snapshot already prevents its own-history invalidation.
reviews.reliability: Binds artifact hashes and re-derives outcomes/candidates. Completion file presence is required, but this adapter does not directly verify the completion seal before deriving it. Exact input-set completeness, direct publication and concurrent history changes remain candidates.

reviews.performance: Every candidate search verifies seal and doctor for all sealed workspaces before filtering an explicit source; profiles and Jaccard sets are repeatedly parsed. Filter/index candidates before expensive verification without skipping seal checks.
reviews.reliability: Keeps canonical target plan verification, source completion/profile identity and no sealed-target mutation. Modern Modules paths collapse to one path-area category. Reuse mutates plan, receipt and journal without rollback; empty candidate indexing and strict text output need fixtures.

reviews.reliability: Enforces chain/unique completions and explicit unhealthy/insufficient states. Registry/workspace receipt writes are not locked or atomic together. Route-ID cohorts do not separate changing policy/model versions; scores reflect governance evidence rather than independent model quality.

reviews.reliability: Binds source fingerprint, instruction-set hash, complexity bands and unique completion lineage. Registry writes are not locked; effectiveness labels are observational, not causal evidence.

reviews.performance: Builds observation arrays by repeated concatenation, computes views more than once and calls complete learning-promotion listing for simple read operations. Indexed event views and request-local lineage could reduce work.
reviews.reliability: Validates sequence/chain, provenance, unique observations, scores and waiver state. Existing registry is not independently rejected before adding observe/waive events; direct unlocked writes and lexical test-root prefix remain candidates. Exposure outcomes are governance summaries, not causal experiment results.
